messages:
Jordan (AE): kicking off the Cobalt POC this week — want to lock scope, success criteria, and who's joining from their side. Can we get a quick agenda and confirm timelines? :eyes:
Riley (SE): +1. Proposed agenda: 1) quick intros 2) Cobalt use cases & expected traffic 3) eval/prompts we should run 4) infra/security checklist 5) success criteria & timelines. 20–30 min.
Amelia (Cobalt): hi all — thanks. Attendees from our side: me (product), Raj (ML), and Sara (infra). 30 min works. Primary goal: improve support deflection by surfacing answer suggestions in our agent UI. Target latency < 300ms 95th, and answer accuracy >= 85% on top-1.
Priya (Sales Eng): thanks Amelia — can you confirm sample volume (avg qps) and typical context size (tokens)? also any banned data / PII constraints?
Amelia (Cobalt): expect ~15 reqs/s peak during business hours, avg context ~400 tokens. We cannot send raw customer PII to hosted vendors; need to discuss Private or Dedicated.
Marcus (Security): noted. We'll need the security questionnaire answers + SOC2 docs. If Private isn't feasible, we can propose Dedicated with VPC peering and KMS. Please upload the questionnaire to the share link before EOD.
Jordan (AE): action items so far: 1) Riley to draft 30-min agenda + sample eval prompts 2) Marcus to list docs needed for security review 3) Amelia to upload a small prompt set & sample logs (anonymized) — target: tomorrow EOD.
Riley (SE): draft prompts for the eval (sharing here):
```
# Prompt 1: concise answer
User: "How do I reset my billing password?"
System: provide step-by-step, include links when available, 1–2 sentences summary at top.

# Prompt 2: suggestion ranking
User: "Customer issue: app crashes on upload"
System: return top-3 troubleshooting steps ranked with confidence scores.
```
Riley (SE): also proposing eval metrics: top-1 accuracy on labeled set, MRR for suggestions, 95th percentile latency, and token cost per session.
Luis (CSM): recommend adding UX acceptance: suggestions should be non-intrusive and editable by agents. We'll measure adoption % and time-to-issue-resolution delta during POC.
Amelia (Cobalt): that UX metric is important. timeline constraints: can only run POC next week (Mon–Thu). Can we complete run + evaluation in 4 days?
Priya (Sales Eng): timeline looks tight but doable if we pre-configure model variants and have prompts ready. Proposed schedule:
- Day 0 (prep): share prompt set + dataset sample
- Day 1: smoke test integration + baseline run
- Day 2–3: full eval (traffic replay)
- Day 4: review results + recommended config
Can you commit anonymized logs by EOD so we can create a traffic replay?
Amelia (Cobalt): yes will share anonymized logs by tonight.
Marcus (Security): quick callout — if they want Hosted API we need a minimal DPA + processing boundary doc. I'll draft that and share.
Jordan (AE): pricing question — Cobalt prefers a predictable commit. Do we want to propose a 1-month trial with a usage cap and optional overage rate? Priya, can you draft a quote with Dedicated vs Hosted estimates (token + reserved GPU hours)?
Priya (Sales Eng): will do. I'll include two options: Hosted test (with strict data handling + transient KV masking) and Dedicated 1-month reserved pool with SLA. Quote by tomorrow morning.
Amelia (Cobalt): sounds good. One more ask — can you include model variants we recommend for cost vs quality tradeoffs? e.g., quantized 8-bit variant vs higher-fidelity baseline.
Riley (SE): yes — will include model matrix and suggested rollouts (canary on 10% then 50%).
Jordan (AE): great. Last thing — quick discovery questions for kickoff (we'll ask these live):
- What are the top 5 user intents you want to deflect?
- How do you label "correct" suggestions today?
- Any blacklisted responses or regulatory constraints?
- Can you share a small sample of support flows we should emulate?
- Who owns acceptance/sign-off on POC success?
Amelia (Cobalt): sign-off will be Raj (ML) + Sara (Infra) + me. We'll answer discovery qs in meeting. See you all Mon 10am PT. :calendar:
Riley (SE): I'll send the calendar invite and attach the agenda + eval prompt file.
Marcus (Security): I'll attach the minimal security docs to the meeting invite too.
Jordan (AE): thanks team — I'll follow up with a checklist and the quote. :thumbsup:
